author: Mavoid123
quote:
The story in these games has always been secondary to me, most of them meh at best.What ruined it for me was what they did with the weapons system and that dumb stuff about not being able to shoot whoever I want, the classification system depending on your crimes is also meh.

A game should be fun to play before anything else, the game looks nice but its not fun to play, the mechanics are clunky and too realistic it is almost as boring as the real world. The people celebrating the dumb changes in the game aren't really people who play videogames too btw.
